Looking for the perfect new construction home in Central Texas? In this video, I take you on an exclusive tour of homes priced around $400,000 in three of the best suburbs for relocation: Troy, Nolanville, and Little River Academy. Whether you're considering moving to the area or just curious about what $400K can buy, you’ll get an inside look at stunning homes with spacious layouts, modern finishes, and fantastic community amenities. From luxury builders to larger lots with endless potential, I cover all the key differences and what makes each neighborhood unique.

If you're thinking about relocating to Central Texas, this video is for you! Don’t miss out on these incredible opportunities. Watch now and let me know which home you’d choose.
